<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <persistence version="3.0" xmlns="https://jakarta.ee/xml/ns/persistence" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="https://jakarta.ee/xml/ns/persistence https://jakarta.ee/xml/ns/persistence/persistence_3_0.xsd">
<!-- Unidade de persistencia --> <persistence-unit name="detetizadora_master" transaction-type="RESOURCE_LOCAL">
<!-- Provider JPA - Hibernate como gerenciador --> <provider>org.hibernate.jpa.HibernatePersistenceProvider</provider>
<!-- Classes mapeadas (as @Entity) - TABELAS --> <class>br.edu.uniamerica.projetomensal.model.Cliente</class> <class>br.edu.uniamerica.projetomensal.model.Funcionario</class> <class>br.edu.uniamerica.projetomensal.model.Servico</class>
<!-- Propriedades de conexao --> <properties> <!-- Conexao PostgreSQL --> <!-- Driver JDBC do PostgreSQL --> <property name="jakarta.persistence.jdbc.driver" value="org.postgresql.Driver"/> <!-- URL de conexao ao banco de dados --> <property name="jakarta.persistence.jdbc.url" value="jdbc:postgresql://localhost:3006/detetizadora_master"/> <!-- Credenciais de acesso ao banco --> <property name="jakarta.persistence.jdbc.user" value="postgres"/> <property name="jakarta.persistence.jdbc.password" value="asdwsad"/>
<!-- Configuracao Hibernate --> <property name="hibernate.dialect" value="org.hibernate.dialect.PostgreSQLDialect"/> <!-- Valida o schema do banco de dados com as entidades mapeadas --> <!-- Valida tabelas, mas nao altera o schema (nao cria, nao atualiza, nao deleta) --> <property name="hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto" value="validate"/> <!-- Exibe as consultas SQL geradas pelo Hibernate no console --> <property name="hibernate.show_sql" value="true"/> <property name="hibernate.format_sql" value="true"/> </properties> </persistence-unit> </persistence>
